main.description: Publish the aggregate-first ad-tech-supply-chain + fraud-network intel report (CID + period + aggregate statistics) into the kotoba Datom log. AGGREGATE-FIRST (sukashi G3): the report carries only aggregate counts (label → count), never per-entity accusations. NON-ADJUDICATING (G4): it states evidence-bearing signals and concentration, never a verdict that an entity committed fraud. A fraud-PROTECTION + ad-tech-TRANSPARENCY map, NEVER a target-list (G2).

reportCid.description: KotobaCid of the published intel report (DataLad→IPFS)

aggregateStats.description: aggregate-first counts only (G3); no per-entity accusations

methodNoteCid.description: optional KotobaCid of the methodology note (how aggregates + signals were computed; sourcing honesty, G5)

sourcing.description: sukashi G5; an aggregate report is typically :synthesized

aggregateStat.description: one aggregate-first count (label → count); never a per-entity accusation (G3/G4)
